description: This file defines the EmployeeLicense entity class for the OrangeHRM system, mapping it to a database table and providing getter and setter methods for its properties related to employee licensing information.

classes.name: EmployeeLicense
classes.description: Entity class representing an employee's license, including license info, issue and expiry dates, linked to Employee and License entities.

methods.name: getLicense
methods.description: Returns the License object associated with this employee license.

methods.name: setLicense
methods.description: Sets the License object for this employee license.

methods.name: getLicenseIssuedDate
methods.description: Returns the date when the license was issued.

methods.name: getEmployee
methods.description: Returns the Employee object associated with this license.

methods.name: setEmployee
methods.description: Sets the Employee object for this license.
